ideas.title: Following the Money in the Feeding Our Future Fraud Scheme
ideas.description: An investigation into the flow of funds in the Feeding Our Future fraud scheme to identify all parties involved and to determine the extent of the fraud.
questions: How did the funds flow through the Feeding Our Future program?
Who were the beneficiaries of the fraudulent funds?
ideas.insight: By following the money, we can identify all parties involved in the fraud scheme and determine the extent of the fraud. This investigation could lead to further guilty pleas and convictions.
